sources.what: cell types, synapse-count connectivity, neuron skeletons
sources.note: public anonymous read of the neuPrint HTTP API

provenance.circuit: cVA: ORN_DA1 -> DA1_lPN/vPN -> lateral-horn relay -> pC1 (P1) / mAL -> descending

selection.lhn: second-order targets of the DA1 projection neurons: neurons receiving >=10 synapses from DA1_lPN/DA1_vPN, excluding the PNs themselves, the dimorphic core, Kenyon cells (KC*) and antennal-lobe local neurons (*LN*), ranked by (synapses from DA1 PNs) x (1 + synapses onto the dimorphic core); top 60. The documented fru+ aSP-f / aSP-g / aSP10 lateral-horn classes are then added (up to 25) whether or not they score.
selection.dimorphic: type prefix "pC1" (male P1/pC1 cluster, <=100) plus the fru+ mAL interneurons (<=45)
selection.descending: superclass descending_neuron, top 30 by synapses from the dimorphic core
selection.other: cb_intrinsic / ol_intrinsic / visual_projection, synweight>=300, spatially stratified for silhouette

provenance.transform: native MaleCNS voxel coords -> recentred, uniform scale into the SPEC box, y negated so dorsal is +y; points outside the brain reference box are dropped (descending axons are truncated at the brain/nerve-cord boundary)
provenance.morphologyNote: polylines are arc-length resamplings of published skeletons; no coordinate is synthesised
provenance.dimorphicFlag: stage == dimorphic, or the release's own fruDsx annotation
